verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing documents its own fraud-adjacent controls at auth time: real-time relayed authorisation, transaction rules that auto-decline, and 3D Secure. It also lets ops suspend or permanently close compromised cards, and cardholders can report fraudulent transactions. The pack never mentions network fraud scores or Adyen fraud models surfaced at authorisation, suspicious-activity alerts, or a reissue/replace-card flow. missing for 10: network or proprietary fraud scores surfaced at auth time, suspicious-activity alerting, documented card reissue tooling, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, the platform fights fraud on my issued cards — network fraud scores or its own models surfaced at auth time, suspicious-activity alerts, and tooling to block and reissue compromised cards
